x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a vulnerable item on a CI with a support group, When it is created, Then the assignment group is set from the CI without manual triage Given two vulnerable items with the same severity, When their CIs differ in business criticality, Then the higher-criticality item has the higher risk score
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: In-scope CIs carry a support group and business criticality so vulnerable items are assigned and prioritised automatically
